_about: Read by: tools/previz/storyboard.py <film>/previz/<G>/storyboard/v<N> (header; layout_note on page 1 when not empty; shots[].shot and .camera; captions[].n and .caption, one per panel), with panels.json from the scene script's --panels run; it writes page-N.png, three panels a page, and adds the fixed footer itself.
Described in: Flow v3.2 - 5 Previz and storyboards (steps 16-20: panels numbered by shot, never by second; no clip time on a panel; no arrows or labels).
layout_note: <LAYOUT, as seen from the camera: where everything is and which way it faces; the grey figures are placeholders whose look is not used. Use an empty string for none.>

shots.camera: CAM FACING <N> | <84>° <wide> | <h> m, <where the camera is> | <locked off>

captions.caption: <What panel 1 shows: who, where in frame, the action. No clip time.>
